Domain Overclock
desc: Accelerates local time for 4 seconds at +60% timescale.

name: Flux Dissolver Battery
desc: Emergency flux vent at 300% rate; launches micromissiles from dissipated flux.

name: Reflector Protocol
desc: Reflects incoming projectiles for 3s; high reflected volume grants a damage and ROF bonus.

name: Dissonance Projector
desc: EMP pulse scaled by current flux. Higher flux yields greater damage.

name: Dimensional Skimmer
desc: Teleports the ship 800u in thrust direction and detonates an EMP pulse on arrival.

name: Stasis Emitter
desc: Slows all ships within 700u; this ship gains damage reduction for 6s.

name: Combat Snapshot
desc: Records position and flux. Reverts after 8s or on second activation. Hull damage is permanent.

name: Flux Ghost Projector
desc: Spawns an autonomous clone of this ship for 20s; clone deals 30% weapon damage and takes 1.5× damage.

name: Neural Uplink
desc: Applies neural uplink bonuses from Synaptic Relay.

name: Tessera Mimic
desc: Spawns bio-mechanical fragments on ship destruction.
